findings.title: Missing Organization JSON-LD Schema
findings.description: Inject this JSON-LD schema into your page head so LLMs can verify your brand identity, name, and URL with certainty. Even well-known brands benefit from explicit schema — it removes any ambiguity when AI engines attribute information.
findings.ai_insight: For Vercel, a platform that helps developers build and deploy fast, scalable websites, missing Organization JSON-LD schema can lead to misattribution of its brand identity and services, potentially confusing its customers and undermining its reputation. As a technology company, Vercel's online presence and credibility are crucial, making it especially important to ensure that its brand information is accurately represented and easily verifiable by AI engines.
